question.problem:
$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{9}{12}(xy+1), & \,{y}^{2}\le x\le 1,\,-1\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

The joint probability density function $f(x,y)$ for the continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ is shown above. Given that 

$$
\text{E}[X]=\frac{3}{5},\,\text{E}[Y]=\frac{1}{7},\,\text{SD}[X]≈0.2619,\,\text{SD}[Y]≈0.4238,
$$

 
find the correlation coefficient of $X$ and $Y.$ Round your answer to $2$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the correlation coefficient of the random variables $X$ and $Y$ is defined as

$$
\rho =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]},
$$

where

- $\text{Cov}[X,Y]$ is the covariance, and

- $\text{SD}[X]$ and $\text{SD}[Y]$ are the standard deviations of $X$ and $Y.$

First, by applying the rule of the lazy statistician, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[XY] & ={∬}_{{R}^{2}}xy\,f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}[{\int }_{{y}^{2}}^{1}xy\cdot \frac{9}{12}(xy+1)\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{9}{12}{\int }_{-1}^{1}[{\int }_{{y}^{2}}^{1}({x}^{2}{y}^{2}+xy)\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{9}{12}{\int }_{-1}^{1}{[\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3}{y}^{2}+\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}y]}_{x={y}^{2}}^{x=1}\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{9}{12}{\int }_{-1}^{1}(\frac{1}{3}{y}^{2}+\frac{1}{2}y-\frac{1}{3}{y}^{8}-\frac{1}{2}{y}^{5})\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{9}{12}{[\frac{1}{9}{y}^{3}+\frac{1}{4}{y}^{2}-\frac{1}{27}{y}^{9}-\frac{1}{12}{y}^{6}]}_{-1}^{1} \\  & =\frac{9}{12}[\frac{1}{9}+\frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{27}-\frac{1}{12}-(-\frac{1}{9}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{27}-\frac{1}{12})] \\  & =\frac{9}{12}(\frac{2}{9}-\frac{2}{27}) \\  & =\frac{1}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we compute the covariance and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Cov}[X,Y] & =\text{E}[XY]-\text{E}[X]\cdot \text{E}[Y] \\  & =\frac{1}{9}-(\frac{3}{5})(\frac{1}{7}) \\  & =\frac{8}{315}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correlation coefficient is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\rho  & =\frac{\text{Cov}[X,Y]}{\text{SD}[X]\cdot \text{SD}[Y]} \\  & ≈\frac{(\frac{8}{315})}{(0.2619)\cdot (0.4238)} \\  & ≈0.23,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $2$ decimal places.
